cwe.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

real_world_analog.summary: Path traversal in Repetier-Server: the file parameter reached the filesystem without canonicalization, allowing arbitrary file reads (CWE-22).
real_world_analog.fix: Resolve the requested name against the log directory and refuse escapes; this case uses an equivalent containment (realpath containment check).
real_world_analog.verification: CVE number and summary confirmed via web search on 2026-11-01; the app in this case is original synthetic code.

note: Self-contained oracle case. Proven directly with effect='canary_read'. No upstream repo/commit applies because the code is original synthetic code written for this case.
license: Original code written for Exhibit A; no third-party code vendored (see README.md).

bypass.expectation: proven against fixed_incomplete: a single `../` removal never touches an absolute name, which still escapes; the incomplete fix must not be accepted as fixed.
